validity.researcher_notes: Answers the length_ratio flag (drawn 72 km vs sheet 242.55 km, ratio 0.30). Standalone PNGRB tariff order for this exact network -- Tariff Order Ref No. TO/2022-23/03, dated 28/07/2022 (https://www.pngrb.gov.in/pdf/orders/NKMRMD_TO_29072022.pdf) -- states: 'Name of Entity: GAIL (India) Limited ("GAIL")', 'Name of Pipeline: Cauvery Basin Natural Gas Pipeline Network (CBPL)', 'Sub-Networks: 1) Narimanam and Kuthalam Sub-Network ("NKM") 2) Ramnad Sub-Network ("RMD")'. The PNGRB Tariff-MIS register (https://pngrb.gov.in/data-bank/20260113-NGPL-Tariff-MIS.pdf) gives NKM = 230.67 km and RMD = 9.62 km, summing to 240.29 km -- within rounding of the sheet's 242.55 km (and the physical-progress register's operating length of 242.0 km, already cited by the register-crosswalk leg's Length [ref] fill for this PID). This is dispositive that the sheet's length is the TWO-sub-network total, not a single trunk: the drawn 72 km geojson traces only one of the two physically separate corridors (NKM and RMD serve different fields/areas within Tamil Nadu/Puducherry), so the ratio undershoot is a coverage gap in the geometry, not a wrong LengthKnownKm. No value change proposed. Company-wide operator note (not separately flagged on this row, so no fill staged here): the same Cauvery tariff order names GAIL as Entity under the PNGRB Act §22 framework covering entities 'laying, building, operating or expanding' the pipeline -- the same operator determination made for P0904/P0923/P0943 in this brief applies to this network too.
